orientation.theme: A magnitude-6-class earthquake in Hokkaido, its measured location and depth, and official confirmation that it caused no damage, casualties, tsunami advisory, or change to an existing megaquake-awareness period.
orientation.thesis: No argumentative thesis is present; the report neutrally states that a moderate earthquake struck northern Japan without reported damage or casualties and was outside the area covered by a recent megaquake advisory.

thesisHinge.proposition: The earthquake caused no damage or casualties and did not alter the existing megaquake advisory arrangements.

orientation.notes: This is a compact factual report. The AP/JMA magnitude 6.2 description and USGS magnitude 6.1 measurement are preserved as a measurement difference, not forced into a contradiction.
